tool_schemas.name: get_current_weather
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided English city name to a canonical location and returns the current-hour weather from cached hourly observations/forecast (refreshing from the upstream provider when missing or stale), including temperature, weather code, and a human-readable condition summary. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `city` is empty or not a string, NOT_FOUND when the city cannot be resolved to a location, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use the tool, and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds the configured invocation quota; provider failures raise UPSTREAM_ERROR.

city.description: The name of the city to fetch weather information for, PLEASE NOTE English name only, if the parameter city isn't English please translate to English before invoking this function.
city.title: City

tool_schemas.name: get_weather_by_datetime_range
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided English city name to a canonical location and returns hourly weather records for the inclusive date range from the cached hourly dataset, fetching and caching missing/stale hours from the upstream provider as needed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `city`, `start_date`, or `end_date` are missing/invalid ISO-8601 dates or when `start_date` is after `end_date`, NOT_FOUND when the city cannot be resolved to a location, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use the tool, and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds the configured invocation quota; provider failures raise UPSTREAM_ERROR.

city.description: The name of the city to fetch weather information for, PLEASE NOTE English name only, if the parameter city isn't English please translate to English before invoking this function.
city.title: City

start_date.description: Start date in format YYYY-MM-DD, please follow ISO 8601 format
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: End date in format YYYY-MM-DD , please follow ISO 8601 format
end_date.title: End Date

tool_schemas.name: get_current_datetime
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current datetime for the given IANA timezone name and records the invocation for auditing and rate-limiting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `timezone_name` is not a valid IANA timezone identifier, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use the tool, and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds the configured invocation quota.

timezone_name.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Use UTC timezone if no timezone provided by the user.
timezone_name.title: Timezone Name

tool_schemas.name: resolve_city
tool_schemas.description: Normalizes the provided English city name (trim, collapse whitespace, title-case) and resolves it to a canonical location, creating or updating a `locations` record as needed. Returns the best match when uniquely resolved; returns candidate matches when ambiguous; refuses with NOT_FOUND when resolution fails and no candidates exist, and with UNAUTHORIZED/RATE_LIMITED/DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the calling API client is not allowed to execute tools.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and rate-limit/quota enforcement.

city.description: English city name to resolve (service will normalize before lookup/insert).

country_code.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to disambiguate (e.g., 'US', 'GB').

admin_region.description: Optional state/province/region hint to disambiguate (free-form, e.g., 'CA', 'Ontario').

prefer_timezone_name.description: Optional IANA timezone name preference used only for tie-breaking.

max_candidates.description: Maximum number of candidates to return when ambiguous.

tool_schemas.name: list_locations
tool_schemas.description: Lists previously resolved/attempted locations visible to the caller, with filtering by resolution status and basic text search. Returns a paginated result set ordered by most recently updated. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is invalid and with RATE_LIMITED/DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller exceeds limits.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and rate-limit/quota enforcement.

country_code.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code filter.

provider.description: Optional provider filter (e.g., the upstream geocoding provider name).

tool_schemas.name: get_location_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single `locations` record by id. Returns the canonical location including coordinates, timezone, and resolution metadata. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when no such location exists, and with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is invalid.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and rate-limit/quota enforcement.

location_id.description: Primary key of the location to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_invocations
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded tool invocations for the authenticated client for auditing and debugging, with filtering by tool name and request status. Returns a paginated result set ordered by most recent first. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is invalid.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and rate-limit/quota enforcement.

from_utc.description: Only return invocations created at or after this UTC timestamp (ISO-8601, e.g. '2026-08-04T00:00:00Z').

to_utc.description: Only return invocations created before this UTC timestamp (ISO-8601, e.g. '2026-08-05T00:00:00Z').

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity and entitlements derived from the provided API key, including client status, allowed usage, and current rate-limit/quota consumption counters. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication.

tool_schemas.name: update_location_resolution_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates the `resolution_status` lifecycle field for a location using only valid transitions (failed↔resolved/ambiguous, ambiguous↔resolved/failed, resolved→ambiguous). Returns the updated location. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when the location does not exist, with CONFLICT when the requested transition is not permitted from the current state, and with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is invalid.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and rate-limit/quota enforcement.

location_id.description: Primary key of the location to update.

resolution_status.description: New resolution status to apply (must be a valid lifecycle transition).

provider.description: Optional provider name to store/update alongside the resolution result.

provider_location_ref.description: Optional upstream provider location reference/id to store/update.

latitude.description: Optional latitude to store when moving to 'resolved'.

longitude.description: Optional longitude to store when moving to 'resolved'.

timezone_name.description: Optional IANA timezone name to store when moving to 'resolved'.

metadata.name: Weather MCP Server

Primary workflows are: (1) normalize/resolve an English city name to a canon
